notes.subject: העל כן
notes.rationale: Rhetorical question (KJV, JPS) vs statement (Wycliffe): 'is it upon this?' — rendered here as a question.

notes.subject: חרם
notes.rationale: Same root as 'thing set apart for destruction' — here a fishing net; net vs destruction-devotion resonance is lost.

notes.subject: יריק
notes.rationale: Root רוק 'pour out/empty' — net emptied of catch, rendered 'pulim i go olgeta'.

translation: Long olsem, em i bai pulim net bilong em i go olgeta, na oltaim long kilim ol lain, na i no ken sori stret?

tokens.gloss: i bai pulim i go olgeta
